description: Defines a template class PriorityWriteScheduler managing HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 stream priorities, registration, state, and scheduling.

classes.name: PriorityWriteScheduler
classes.description: Manages stream registration, priority updates, readiness states, and scheduling for HTTP/2/HTTP/3 streams.

methods.name: RegisterStream
methods.description: Registers a new stream with a specified priority.

methods.name: UnregisterStream
methods.description: Removes a stream from the scheduler.

methods.name: StreamRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a stream is registered.

methods.name: GetStreamPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of a stream.

methods.name: UpdateStreamPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of a registered stream.

methods.name: RecordStreamEventTime
methods.description: Records the time of a read/write event for a stream.

methods.name: GetLatestEventWithPriority
methods.description: Gets the latest event time for streams with higher priority.

methods.name: PopNextReadyStream
methods.description: Returns and marks the next ready stream as not ready.

methods.name: PopNextReadyStreamAndPriority
methods.description: Returns and marks the next ready stream and its priority.

methods.name: ShouldYield
methods.description: Determines if a stream should yield to higher priority streams.

methods.name: MarkStreamReady
methods.description: Marks a stream as ready to write.

methods.name: MarkStreamNotReady
methods.description: Marks a stream as not ready.

methods.name: HasReadyStreams
methods.description: Checks if any streams are ready.

methods.name: NumReadyStreams
methods.description: Returns the count of ready streams.

methods.name: NumRegisteredStreams
methods.description: Returns the total number of registered streams.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Provides a string summary of internal state.

methods.name: IsStreamReady
methods.description: Checks if a specific stream is marked as ready.
